name: fix-2026-10-31b
title: Fixes of 2026-10-31, second batch: solids stay on the floor (#2630) and many free vectors (#1310)

cases.title: A triangle with two side lengths stays flat on the floor
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» a few times: the triangle's shape changes, but it always lies flat, AB along the floor, and AB always draws longer than AC.
cases.before: From the second configuration on, the triangle tipped up off the floor.

cases.title: A pyramid with given edges keeps its base down and its apex up
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». At every «הציגו תצורה אחרת» the base ABCD sits on the floor and S is above it.
cases.before: The pyramid tumbled; in the third configuration it was upside-down, S below the floor.

cases.title: A box with three edge lengths stays upright
cases.lookFor: In every screenshot ABCD is on the floor and A'B'C'D' above it.
cases.before: The box tumbled from the second configuration on.

cases.title: A vector given by its components keeps them
cases.lookFor: Every row is green; AB points along (1,2,3) in the axes, not along the floor's x direction.
cases.before: The figure was turned so AB lay along x, (3.74, 0, 0), and the row «AB = (1,2,3)» was marked wrong.

cases.title: A second free vector keeps the first one
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Both arrows, AB and CD, are drawn and both rows are green.
cases.before: Only CD was drawn: the AB arrow vanished.

cases.title: Three free vectors, all drawn
cases.lookFor: Three arrows, AB, CD and EF; three green rows.
cases.before: Only the last arrow was drawn.

cases.title: Your T35 figure stays flat (vector first, then the triangle)
cases.lookFor: Every row green; the triangle lies flat with AB along the floor in every configuration.
